newsitem.title: GERMANY: Record sales boost Adidas profits in 96.
newsitem.headline: Record sales boost Adidas profits in 96.

text.p: German sports retail group Adidas AG said on Tuesday record sales in 1996 lifted group operating profit to 360 million marks ($211.4 million) in 1996 from 243 million marks the year before.
Sales climbed 35 percent during the year to 4.71 billion marks and earnings per share surged to 6.93 marks from 5.40 marks, the company said.
European sales were especially strong, climbing to 3.1 billion marks from 2.3 billion marks -- the first time European sales were over three billion marks.
The company said it plans a dividend for the year of 1.10 marks per share. Pre-tax profit climbed 50 percent to 444 million marks.
Chairman Robert Louis-Dreyfus said the results showed that Adidas was on the way to becoming the "best sports brand in the world." ($ = 1.702 German Marks)
